item.title: Three Distinct Cycling Logo Options

turns.text: Give me three different logo options for my cycling club, Moss & Mile. Simple green and black on white, each with the name and a small symbol. Your call on the symbols, but make them genuinely different ideas. Three separate square images please, not a collage.

item.tests: Produces exactly three separately usable logo variations with distinct concepts and consistent required wording.

answer_sheet.Exact wording: Moss & Mile on every option, including the ampersand; no extra text.
answer_sheet.Number and delivery: Three separate square images, not one collage or contact sheet.
answer_sheet.Style and palette: Simple cycling-club logos using green and black on white.
answer_sheet.How different the options should be: Three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts, not just recolors of one design.

must_haves: Exactly three separate square logo images are delivered.
Each logo clearly reads 'Moss & Mile', including the ampersand.
Each option includes a small symbol alongside or above the name.
The three options have visibly different symbol or layout concepts, rather than only color changes.
All three use green and black on plain white backgrounds without mockup scenes or option labels.

turns.text: Could you make three different logo options for my cycling club? I’m excited to see some ideas because I’ve been having trouble picturing what would feel right for the club. The name is Moss & Mile, and each option should include that exact wording, including the ampersand, with no extra text, plus a small symbol. I’d like three separate square images at 640 × 640 px each, not a collage or contact sheet. Please keep the logos simple, using green and black on white. The symbols and fonts are your call, but I do mean three genuinely different symbol or layout concepts rather than just recolors of the same design.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make any of the logos. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it refused every image request and nothing was created.

I tried all three logos with the qwen-image-2.1 model, which costs about 10 credits per image. Then I tried one logo with flux-2-klein, the cheapest model on the free plan at about 5 credits per image. That was refused as well. Once you have more credits (about 15–30 for all three, depending on the model), I can run them again. Each would be a separate square image at 640 × 640 px, green and black on white, with only the words "Moss & Mile."

Here are the three ideas I had ready:

1. **Leaf wheel, stacked layout:** a small bicycle wheel whose spokes form a green moss leaf. "Moss & Mile" sits below it in a bold black sans-serif font with clean, rounded letter shapes.
2. **Winding road, side-by-side layout:** a small green road curving over a rounded hill on the left. "Moss & Mile" sits on one line to the right in an elegant black serif font.
3. **Circle badge:** a thin black circle outline with a small green fern sprout at the top. "Moss & Mile" runs across the middle in narrow black capital letters, with the ampersand in green.

Let me know when your credits are topped up, or if you'd like to change any of these ideas first.
